_note: Tier 2, oldest end. 7-9 October 2025: the royals, the Mahdi, Romania, and the Canada iron curtain.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying to watch the royals, England, Saudi Arabia and the Mayans down in South America and Mexico, and starts to speak about ancestors before breaking off.
mentions.quote: Watch the royals. England, Saudi Arabia, the Mayans
mentions.falsify_match: A connection surfacing between the British crown, Saudi Arabia and Mesoamerica.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A list of things to watch with no act attached.

mentions.claim_text: He names another commentator who he says will confirm what he is saying, but insists he is telling them by what he saw by the Spirit.
mentions.quote: They will confirm what you are saying
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: naming an outside source of corroboration while asserting independence from it.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Spirit saying they are disguised in plain view and that you do not realise who is among you.
mentions.quote: Disguised in plain view, you do not realize who is among you
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: hidden actors, defined as undetectable.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He describes King Charles poised to strike Australia, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland and France, turning his body like a scorpion.
mentions.quote: he was poised to strike Australia Canada the United Kingdom
mentions.falsify_match: Action by the British monarch against Commonwealth states.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. An allegation about a named living head of state with no act specified.

mentions.claim_text: He says something is coming up out of Saudi Arabia and the Mahdi will come from there, that he still believes it is the Saudi crown prince, and notes others say Obama while he says prince.
mentions.quote: you will see the Mahdi coming from there. I still believe he is MBS
mentions.falsify_match: The Saudi crown prince taking a role answering to the Mahdi.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not. Marked by him as personal opinion, which is the honest hedge.

mentions.claim_text: He rejects a claim about the president outright and says God sent him for such a time as this to give America one last call, a three and a half year reprieve before a major shaking.
mentions.quote: A three and a half year reprieve before a major shaking
mentions.falsify_match: A major shaking arriving about three and a half years from October 2025, so around spring 2029.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Note the window has now been given as four years, then three and a half, then out to 2030.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks to the weather as drought tries to set in over Oklahoma and Texas, reporting the Lord saying they have power and authority because weather manipulation is coming.
mentions.quote: As drought tries to set in over Oklahoma and Texas
mentions.falsify_match: Drought across Oklahoma and Texas.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Both states were already in drought when this was said, which is why he speaks against it rather than forecasting it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees a great move of God around California like the Azusa Street revival, and that it will not be in just one place.
mentions.quote: I see another move like in Azusa Street Revival
mentions.falsify_match: A revival in California comparable to Azusa Street.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A named comparison, which sets a recognisable scale.

mentions.claim_text: Praying over Poland he says it is all bad, and asks for the country starting with B, settling on Belarus which he says is highlighted.
mentions.quote: What is the one that starts with a B? Belarus
mentions.falsify_match: Belarus drawn into the Poland conflict.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. The name is retrieved with help rather than given.

mentions.claim_text: Amid tongues he says it is happening in Israel at the same time and he sees explosions going off in Israel again.
mentions.quote: I see like explosions going off in Israel again
mentions.falsify_match: Renewed strikes on Israel concurrent with the European escalation.
mentions.falsify_miss: None concurrent.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will expand and will not stay in Ukraine, that it is trying to spread.
mentions.quote: It will not just be in Ukraine. It is trying to expand
mentions.falsify_match: The war spreading beyond Ukraine.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not.

mentions.claim_text: Amid tongues he names Romania repeatedly and asks whether it is a portal there.
mentions.quote: Romania. They are portal
mentions.falsify_match: Romania becoming a route or entry point in the war.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Portal is not interpreted.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a missile with a red tip coming out of that area and going into Moscow, identifying it against an image on screen.
mentions.quote: I see them coming out of this area going into Moscow
mentions.falsify_match: Long range missiles with the described marking striking Moscow.
mentions.falsify_miss: None have.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are coming out of submarines, that he sees submarines, and that they will shoot them off from the ocean down there.
mentions.quote: They are coming out of submarines
mentions.falsify_match: Submarine-launched strikes in the conflict.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The launch platform is the checkable detail.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees China lurking in the background and that China will try to take Taiwan, highlighted again.
mentions.quote: China will try to take Taiwan
mentions.falsify_match: A Chinese attempt on Taiwan.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Undated.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees buildings with the lights on in those areas, hears the words pressure to produce, and that he has turned his face toward Taiwan.
mentions.quote: I hear the word pressure to produce and he is looking at Taiwan
mentions.falsify_match: Economic pressure inside China driving a move on Taiwan.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not.

mentions.claim_text: He says Kim is being promised much like a brotherhood and is trying to come to the forefront, with Russia summoning him and saying help us and we will help you.
mentions.quote: Help us and we will help you
mentions.falsify_match: A reciprocal Russia and North Korea bargain becoming visible.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. North Korean troops in Russia were already reported from late 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord is taking him back to Europe and that he sees Macron and trouble.
mentions.quote: I see Macron. I see trouble
mentions.falsify_match: Political trouble for the French president.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Trouble carries no content.

mentions.claim_text: He says a digital ID is coming with all of this, that Jesus Christ is coming, that it will escalate like never before, and that he sees Tomahawk missiles going into Moscow.
mentions.quote: I see Tomahawk missiles going into Moscow
mentions.falsify_match: Tomahawk missiles striking Moscow.
mentions.falsify_miss: None have. A named weapon and a named target.

mentions.claim_text: He says it gets out of control, asks whether they can stop it, and says that in his spirit as he prayed into it, it was pretty big.
mentions.quote: And it gets out of control. So, can we stop it?
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a question about whether prayer can avert what he has described.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that Romania was really highlighted, asks whether Romania is close to Ukraine, is told they share a border, and apologises for not being good at geography.
mentions.quote: I am not real good at geography
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: the geography is supplied to him in the room after the name comes.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim. Worth keeping because it shows he did not know where Romania was when he named it.

mentions.claim_text: He says the news that day about Cuba and about Canada is very alarming against the prophetic words he has given concerning Cuba.
mentions.quote: very alarming for what we have seen today in the news
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: news read against his standing Cuba material.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says what is coming to Canada troubles him, and that he saw something like an iron curtain with freedoms being stripped away.
mentions.quote: I saw trying to be an iron curtain
mentions.falsify_match: Canadian legislation removing civil freedoms at that scale.
mentions.falsify_miss: None passed.

mentions.claim_text: He says if they shut that down the spirit behind it is the antichrist spirit, and that as the Canadians rise up he saw Holy Ghost fire coming.
mentions.quote: that spirit is the antichrist spirit
mentions.falsify_match: A religious awakening in Canada in response to legal restriction.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The spirit attribution has no observable test.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw whiskey barrels rolling down and an economy in trouble, and that the Lord said great trying times would come upon it.
mentions.quote: I saw the whiskey barrels rolling down
mentions.falsify_match: A serious Canadian economic downturn.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The barrels are not interpreted.

mentions.claim_text: He says that as the oil came forth he saw a great mighty move of God on the Canadians coming out of pressure, then trying to go over Europe, with the antichrist spirit trying to come.
mentions.quote: I SAW A GREAT MIGHTY MOVE OF GOD COMING UPON THE CANADIANS
mentions.falsify_match: A Canadian revival spreading to Europe.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. No measure.

mentions.claim_text: He says this escalation concerns him most because it is close to home, and that he saw an extension running from Russia to Cuba.
mentions.quote: I saw an extension from Russia to Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: A Russian military or strategic presence extended to Cuba.
mentions.falsify_miss: None established.
